{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-0dgd","title":"GNSS-synchronized frequency hopping (CCP-12)","description":"Implement network-wide synchronized frequency hopping using GNSS-derived time.

## Overview
When GNSS time is available, nodes derive SFN (superframe number) from UTC and use
synchronized_hop_channel(sfn, seed, n_channels) so the entire network hops together.
Falls back to epoch-based hash selection when GNSS unavailable.

## Algorithm
```
sfn = (unix_time_ms - EPOCH_BASE_MS) // SUPERFRAME_DURATION_MS
channel = 1 + fnv1a32(seed || sfn) % (n_channels - 1)
```

## Requirements
- SFN derivation from HAL time snapshot
- Config: enable/disable, superframe duration (default 100ms), seed
- Graceful fallback when GNSS lost
- Shared test vectors across implementations
- Python, Rust, Zephyr C implementations
